# Nimbus

The revolutionary AI-powered ecosystem for modern developers. Production-ready. Secure. Blazing fast.

## Architecture

Built with Python, Redis and PostgreSQL. Includes tags, agents, templates, dashboards and integrations.

## Installation

Deploy PostgreSQL and Redis. Then run:

```sh
python app.py --config settings.yaml
```

## Examples

Nimbus analyses failed CI logs and suggests patches. Users review, apply and test each suggestion manually. Experimental; tested only with GitHub Actions logs under 1 MB.
